notes:
SWIT QB Companion 2.0.0-beta.62

Bank rules: Journal entry. A rule can record a line as a journal entry (bank charges, GCT, interest), with the account it posts to and an optional class; the journal entry opens filled in.
Bank rules: Insurance EOB. A rule can open the Insurance EOB for money in from an insurer.
Also in this version: a rule applies as soon as it’s made (Record this line now), and a direct payment rule names its GL account.

Includes everything from 2.0.0-beta.56 to 61.
